test_title: PYST 34 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Awareness (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question:
Which of the following is a reason of Brain drain in India?

I. Low job opportunities in India

II. Low quality of higher education in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Low job opportunities in India:** 
• The lack of sufficient and suitable employment opportunities in India has been a major cause of **brain drain**. 
• Many skilled and educated individuals move abroad in search of better-paying jobs, enhanced career growth, and improved working conditions. 
• The unemployment rate in India, which has fluctuated over the years, often contributes to individuals choosing to migrate. *Hence, statement I is correct.* 
• **Low quality of higher education in India:** 
• Although India has numerous educational institutions, the **quality of higher education** often fails to meet global standards. 
• Factors such as outdated curricula, limited research opportunities, and insufficient infrastructure drive students to pursue education in developed countries offering cutting-edge facilities. 
• India ranks lower in global university rankings, which influences students' decisions to study abroad. *Hence, statement II is correct.* 
• **Combined impact of both factors:** 
• The combination of inadequate job opportunities and the substandard quality of higher education creates a strong push factor for migration. 
• Countries with better opportunities and higher-quality education attract Indian talent, leading to a continuous brain drain. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Brain Drain:** 
• **Definition:** Brain drain refers to the emigration of highly skilled and educated individuals from their home country to another nation for better opportunities. 
• **Major destinations:** Countries like the **United States, Canada, Australia, and the United Kingdom** are popular destinations for Indian migrants due to their better job markets and education systems. 
• **Impact on India:** Brain drain negatively affects India's economic growth as it leads to a loss of skilled workforce required for innovation and development. 
• **Government Initiatives to curb brain drain:** 
• The Indian government has launched programs like **Skill India Mission** and **Startup India** to encourage entrepreneurship and create more job opportunities. 
• Efforts are being made to improve the quality of higher education by establishing world-class universities and increasing funding for research. 
• **Statistical Data:** 
• According to the **United Nations**, India has one of the largest diasporas globally, with over **18 million people** living outside the country (2020 data). 
• In 2021, nearly **1 lakh Indian students** migrated to foreign countries for higher education, highlighting the extent of brain drain. 
• **Reasons for global preference:** 
• Developed nations offer better infrastructure, higher salaries, and advanced research opportunities. 
• Scholarships and financial aid provided by foreign universities attract students from developing countries like India. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Role of Education Rankings:** Indian universities often fail to secure top positions in **QS World Rankings** or **Times Higher Education Rankings**, influencing students to opt for foreign institutions. 
• **Economic factors:** The disparity in salaries between India and developed countries contributes significantly to brain drain. 
• **Reverse Brain Drain:** Some initiatives like **Make in India** aim to attract skilled professionals back to India by creating favorable conditions for their return. 
• **Technological advancements:** Developed countries often provide access to cutting-edge technologies, which is a major pull factor for skilled professionals. </ul
